description: Evaluation set for the legal assistant. 'gold' lists article indexes in clean_dataset_v2.json whose text answers the question. 'answerable' questions have a gold article; 'unanswerable' are legal questions the corpus does not cover (correct behaviour: say so); 'out_of_scope' are not legal questions (correct behaviour: redirect).
